canonical_tex.coverage_rule: Every nonblank noncomment line inside the document body contributes to the ordered coverage digest even when it is structural or intentionally has no semantic-candidate item. Candidate extraction is deliberately overinclusive; contraction requires an explicit reviewed disposition.

repository_surface.coverage_rule: Every blob below the admitted roots at the pinned predecessor commit has one repository-file item. Every source line beginning with Rust visibility syntax has an additional public-surface item, including re-exports and macro-generated declaration templates even when exact parsing remains pending. Rust and schema items are implementation evidence, never TeX semantic authority.

conformance_surface.fixture_id_law: A displayed fixture label may contain slash-delimited phase components and may end in one uppercase variant letter after the final three digits. The entire first token must match; prefix matches are forbidden.
conformance_surface.row_identity_law: Every matching Markdown status-row occurrence has its own source identity. A displayed label may name more than one row, so label equality never merges source occurrences.
conformance_surface.coverage_rule: Every fixture-row occurrence and every executable PASS-evidence registry entry is inventoried. A unique displayed label may join its row to one registry entry; repeated labels retain separate rows, and a registry relation is never manufactured across an ambiguous repeated label. A registry entry without any status row remains an explicit review residual.

identity.content_identity: class plus normalized content digest; exact duplicate content receives a deterministic occurrence suffix within its pinned source
identity.path_identity: pinned repository path for whole-file surfaces; public declarations additionally bind kind, name, normalized declaration digest, and occurrence
identity.line_numbers: source loci only and never the sole stable identity

gate_law: Generation and source coverage do not pass Gate A. Gate A remains pending while any consequential candidate has review_status pending, while an admitted source unit is unmatched, or while an executable fixture lacks its required claim edge.
